profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Progress
profile.summary: I consider myself a strong software engineering generalist. I have experience in several different areas including lower-level c/c++ development, frontend Javascript (including ES6+), scripting (bash/perl), database design, SQL, build management (including autotools, cmake, and others), continuous integration, migrating and unit testing legacy code, algorithm design, UI design, etc. I like to solve interesting problems and learn things along the way.
